root.description: Observed canonical root, or the requested root when absent.

candidateMatch.description: Present only when the probe named a candidate folder and the registration is present. same: the candidate is the registration's recorded folder (equal spelling, or resolved to it by the registry's own canonicalization, or the two directories' filesystem identity proves them one). different: the candidate resolved to another directory AND the two directories' own identity proves them distinct — a mere string difference is never enough, and no case normalization is promised on any volume. unknown: the comparison cannot be decided now (unresolvable candidate or unavailable identity evidence); never treated as different. The resolved form is never returned.
